result.title: OntoAR-HAR: Ontology-Guided Agentic RAG with Personalized Memory for Human Activity Recognition
result.summary: LLMs increasingly support sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) by linking motion signals with activity semantics and physical knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds decisions in sensor examples and domain features, enabling training-free target-user inference with less dependence on raw numerical arrays. However, existing LLM/RAG-based HAR typically searches single-level activity spaces using static population knowledge. Consequently, they compare many unrelated candidates using the same static population evidence and overlook personalized motion patterns. We propose OntoAR-HAR, an ontology-guided agentic RAG framework combining static population and personalized knowledge. Its tree-structured activity ontology decomposes classification into local decisions among semantically related activities. The static store supplies node-constrained examples, while offline-discovered executable signal features provide numerical evidence for local distinctions. During inference, the personalized store collects selected user observations, which the LLM integrates with static knowledge and signal features while traversing the ontology to an activity label. Cross-subject and heterogeneous-sensing experiments show complementary gains from hierarchical retrieval and personalized memory across multiple LLM backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance. By explicitly modeling hierarchical relations across activity granularities, OntoAR-HAR also addresses the long-overlooked semantic inclusion problem and avoids treating related labels as independent categories.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OntoAR-HAR，一个本体引导的 agentic RAG 框架，用树状活动本体把分类拆解为语义相近活动间的局部决策，并结合静态群体检索样例、离线挖掘的可执行信号特征与推理期收集的个性化记忆，让 LLM 沿本体遍历输出活动标签。
AI.relevance_reason: 任务域是传感器 HAR，与视觉 latent 推理无直接关系；但其「按语义层级把判别拆成局部候选决策」和「个性化证据库＋动态检索」的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、候选剪枝与何时停止取证的决策提供可核查线索。
